tools.name: onecrm_whoami
tools.description: Show the 1CRM user the connection signs in as (id, user name, name). Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: onecrm_get_module_fields
tools.description: List the fields of a 1CRM module with their types and labels. Use it before you filter, sort or write a module.

tools.name: onecrm_list_records
tools.description: List records of a 1CRM module, with optional equality filters, text search, sort, fields, offset and limit (max 100). Returns records and total_results. Use onecrm_get_module_fields for the field names.

tools.name: onecrm_get_record
tools.description: Get one record of a 1CRM module by id, with all fields or only the fields you pass.

tools.name: onecrm_list_related_records
tools.description: List the records linked to one record through a relationship link (for example the contacts of an account). The link name is the relationship name from onecrm_get_module_fields. Same paging and filters as onecrm_list_records.

tools.name: onecrm_create_record
tools.description: Create one record in a 1CRM module from the field values you pass (for example a new Lead). Creates only; it changes no existing record. Returns the new id.

tools.name: onecrm_update_record
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on one existing record of a 1CRM module. Only the given fields change. It never deletes a record; use the 1CRM interface for that.
